801fd1e3-c395-47de-bcd0-87d3a416f584.description: Error ratio over 5m is above 14.4x the 1% error budget (fast burn); at this rate a 30-day budget lasts about 2 days.

facts.statement: Checkout's error spans are dominated by CurrencyService/Convert failing with 'connection refused' to 10.96.152.124:8080 (20 spans in 30m, 10 in the last 10m).
Currency's last log line is 'Received SIGTERM, shutting down Currency Server' at 19:23:47Z; it logs nothing afterward, and has no error traces in the window.
Frontend's 'failed to convert price' error logs start at 19:23:55Z, about 8s after currency's SIGTERM.
Checkout's error ratio rose from about 0.105 at 19:24:30Z to 0.62 at 19:26:30Z, so onset is about 19:24-19:25Z.
The only error series among checkout's client spans is CurrencyService/Convert (about 0.143 errors/s). Payment, cart and product-catalog have no client error series.
Currency's server p95 is flat at about 1.9 ms, and its Convert spans show only STATUS_CODE_OK with no error-status series.
All 18 flagd flags are off by default; no flag change explains the onset.
Checkout, payment, cart, product-catalog and shipping each have a single revision (rollout_history) created about 19:11Z, with no later change. Currency's rollout history was not checked.
The 7 Warning events in otel-demo over 120 minutes are readiness probe failures on otel-collector-agent, alertmanager and loki; none involve currency or checkout's dependencies.
Checkout's single pod has no warning, restart or OOM events. Payment's error logs are empty over 30 minutes.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Check currency's Deployment replicas and rollout history, its Kubernetes events and pod status for 19:20-19:25Z, and whether the node or pod was evicted.
hypotheses.statement: Currency was scaled down, evicted or OOM-killed around 19:23:47Z, and its Deployment or ReplicaSet was not restored.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Query currency's Convert server span rate per pod and its endpoints for 10.96.152.124 after 19:23:47Z, and confirm the Service has no ready endpoints.
hypotheses.statement: Currency's server spans still show about 0.23/s OK after 19:23:47Z. This may be stale data, a second replica, or spans from a different pod, which would contradict the 'currency down' reading.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Compare checkout's CURRENCY_ADDR env and the currency Service's port and clusterIP, and look for a recent config change.
hypotheses.statement: Checkout's Convert client address or port was changed, so it points at a dead endpoint. This is less likely because the same path worked until about 19:24Z.

inferences.statement: Currency is the failing service. Its SIGTERM at 19:23:47Z precedes checkout's onset (about 19:24Z) and the frontend symptoms (19:23:55Z), and checkout's refused connections to its address match a process that is no longer listening.
The fault is not in checkout's config, flags or resources, and not in payment, cart or product-catalog, because none of them shows errors or changes that match the onset.

root_causes.cause: Currency server stopped at about 19:23:47Z (SIGTERM, no logs after) and is not accepting connections on 10.96.152.124:8080, so checkout's Convert calls are refused and checkout fails its orders. The reason for the stop is unknown.

Not the root cause. Checkout surfaces the currency failure: its error spans are connection-refused Convert calls, and its own logs show no fault. Its own config is unlikely to have changed, since the errors began only after currency stopped.

diagnosis.summary: Checkout's fast error burn is caused by the currency service being down. Currency logged 'Received SIGTERM' at 19:23:47Z and nothing afterward. From about 19:24Z, checkout's gRPC calls to CurrencyService/Convert (10.96.152.124:8080) were refused with connection refused. Checkout's PlaceOrder failures, frontend's 'failed to convert price' errors (from 19:23:55Z) and frontend-proxy's error rise all follow from that. Payment, cart and product-catalog show no errors, and no flag, rollout or event change touches checkout or its other dependencies. The reason for currency's SIGTERM (scale-down, eviction, OOM or manual stop) is not established, and currency's own rollout history and events were not checked.

actions.reason: Currency stopped at 19:23:47Z (SIGTERM, container killed and restarted by kubelet) and checkout's Convert calls to 10.96.152.124:8080 are refused. No release caused it: currency has one revision from 19:11Z. A rolling restart should restore the listener. Root cause of the stop is still unknown.

alternatives.why_not: Currency has only revision 1 (created 19:11:23Z, no change cause), so there is no earlier revision to return to and no bad release.
The fault is that the currency endpoint refuses connections, not a shortage of capacity. Adding replicas would not fix a single pod that is not listening.

plan.summary: Currency is the broken service: it stopped at 19:23:47Z and checkout's Convert calls to it are refused. A rolling restart of currency is proposed because no release is involved. A human should still find out why the container was killed (events show 'definition changed') and confirm checkout's error ratio drops after the restart.
